sections.text: - Used in the story chapter Batya

sections.heading: Transcript
sections.text:
Moreman: …He's like a mother duck!

Taran: Explain.

Moreman: You don't get it, Taran? Like a fucking mother duck! Remember how… how Voevoda got us out of the line of fire last time. Made us all walk outta there in a straight line like some ducklings. Fucking… heh…

Taran: Yeah, I remember. No one got hurt, at least. And the job was done.

Moreman: Well I'm not saying it's a bad thing! Who do you take me for? Our commander is like a real batya to me.

Voevoda: What are we up to here, pups?

Moreman: Comrade commander, everything here is strictly by the book! Come join us!

Voevoda: No thanks. Alright, get ready, we're heading out soon.

Moreman: Aye, commander!
